_meta.purpose: E11 real-execution sandbox fixtures. Deterministic, committed, seed-fixed. Materialized into a per-run temp workspace by sandbox_env.executor.SandboxWorkspace.
_meta.note: Fixture-backed families succeed when the model's arguments are in-domain and return status=error (not_found/invalid_args) when out-of-domain, which is the real, non-oracle signal that drives PTE-FD escalation.

rag_index.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation overview
rag_index.text: RAG combines a retriever over a vector index with a generator to ground answers in documents.

rag_index.title: LLM agent tool use survey
rag_index.text: LLM agents select and invoke tools; progressive tool exposure reduces prompt tokens and selection errors.

rag_index.title: Function calling schema design
rag_index.text: Function calling schemas describe tool name, description and JSON parameters for model selection.

rag_index.title: Context compression for long sessions
rag_index.text: Context compression prunes tool results and summarizes old turns to stay within the token budget.

rag_index.title: Vector databases and embeddings
rag_index.text: Vector databases store embeddings and support approximate nearest neighbour search for semantic retrieval.

rag_index.title: Experience replay in agents
rag_index.text: Experience replay stores past tool outcomes and reuses them to avoid repeated failures.

rag_index.title: Prompt injection defenses
rag_index.text: Prompt injection defenses validate untrusted content and constrain tool authorization boundaries.

rag_index.title: Evaluating tool selection accuracy
rag_index.text: Tool selection accuracy measures whether the chosen tool is in the acceptable set for a query.

rag_index.title: Knowledge base construction
rag_index.text: A knowledge base indexes documents by keywords and vectors to support question answering.

rag_index.title: Failure-driven escalation
rag_index.text: Failure-driven escalation broadens the exposed tool tier after consecutive execution errors.

rag_index.title: Semantic search with BM25
rag_index.text: BM25 ranks documents by term frequency and inverse document frequency for keyword search.

rag_index.title: Multi-step agent planning
rag_index.text: Multi-step planning decomposes a task into tool calls executed in sequence with feedback.

poetry_db.title: 静夜思
poetry_db.author: 李白
poetry_db.text: 床前明月光，疑是地上霜。举头望明月，低头思故乡。

poetry_db.title: 将进酒
poetry_db.author: 李白
poetry_db.text: 君不见黄河之水天上来，奔流到海不复回。

poetry_db.title: 望庐山瀑布
poetry_db.author: 李白
poetry_db.text: 日照香炉生紫烟，遥看瀑布挂前川。

poetry_db.title: 春望
poetry_db.author: 杜甫
poetry_db.text: 国破山河在，城春草木深。感时花溅泪，恨别鸟惊心。

poetry_db.title: 登高
poetry_db.author: 杜甫
poetry_db.text: 风急天高猿啸哀，渚清沙白鸟飞回。

poetry_db.title: 水调歌头
poetry_db.author: 苏轼
poetry_db.text: 明月几时有，把酒问青天。但愿人长久，千里共婵娟。

poetry_db.title: 念奴娇·赤壁怀古
poetry_db.author: 苏轼
poetry_db.text: 大江东去，浪淘尽，千古风流人物。

poetry_db.title: 相思
poetry_db.author: 王维
poetry_db.text: 红豆生南国，春来发几枝。愿君多采撷，此物最相思。

poetry_db.title: 登鹳雀楼
poetry_db.author: 王之涣
poetry_db.text: 白日依山尽，黄河入海流。欲穷千里目，更上一层楼。

poetry_db.title: 春晓
poetry_db.author: 孟浩然
poetry_db.text: 春眠不觉晓，处处闻啼鸟。夜来风雨声，花落知多少。

poetry_db.title: 夜雨寄北
poetry_db.author: 李商隐
poetry_db.text: 君问归期未有期，巴山夜雨涨秋池。

poetry_db.title: 游子吟
poetry_db.author: 孟郊
poetry_db.text: 慈母手中线，游子身上衣。临行密密缝，意恐迟迟归。
